name: Golden embers
description: Animates the subject to ignite in rising golden embers and heat shimmer.
aliases: ignite in rising golden embers and heat shimmer

prompt.default: The subject begins still, then proceeds to ignite in rising golden embers and heat shimmer. The subject glows from within like hot coals and the embers grow denser until the end of the shot, sparks drifting upward through warm heat distortion. High-speed studio cinematography, physically accurate reflections and particle motion, locked camera.
